record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let z(N0) be a shift-monotone sequence ideal, and let L^{APP}_z be the operator ideal consisting of all bounded operators S between Banach spaces for which the dyadic approximation-number sequence (a_{2^k}(S)) belongs to z(N0). Theorem 1.19 constructs traces on L^{APP}_z from (1/2)S_+-invariant linear forms φ on z(N0) by choosing a z-representation S=∑_{k>=0} S_k and setting φ_z(S)=φ((2^{-k} trace(S_k))_k). Show that every trace on L^{APP}_z is of this form, so that L^{APP}_z carries no traces other than those produced in Theorem 1.19.

evidence.quote:
Problem 5. Show that on LAPP
z there exist no other traces than those provided
by Theorem 1.19.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

Let $\mathbb{N}_0=\{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the space of bounded scalar sequences indexed by $\mathbb{N}_0$. The forward dyadic shift is the linear map $S_+\colon \ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)\to\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ defined by $(S_+ x)_k = x_{k-1}$ for $k\ge 1$ and $(S_+ x)_0=0$. A linear subspace $z(\mathbb{N}_0)\subseteq c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is called a shift-monotone sequence ideal if it is solid (i.e.\ $|y_k|\le |x_k|$ for all $k$ and $x\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ imply $y\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$) and satisfies $S_+ x\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ whenever $x\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

For a bounded linear operator $S\colon X\to Y$ between Banach spaces, the $n$-th approximation number is
$$a_n(S)=\inf\{\,\|S-A\|: A\colon X\to Y, \mathrm{rank}(A)<n\,\},\qquad n\ge 1.$$
Define the operator ideal
$$\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{z}=\bigl\{\,S\in\mathfrak{L}(X,Y):\ X,Y\text{ Banach},\ (a_{2^k}(S))_{k\ge 0}\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)\,\bigr\}.$$
A $z$-representation of $S\in\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z(X,Y)$ is a series $S=\sum_{k\ge 0} S_k$ converging in operator norm with $\mathrm{rank}(S_k)\le 2^k$ and such that $(\|S_k\|)_{k\ge 0}\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$; every $S\in\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ admits such a representation.

A trace on $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ is a linear functional $\tau$ defined on the components $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z(X,X)$ for all Banach spaces $X$ such that $\tau(BA)=\tau(AB)$ whenever the products make sense and lie in $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$, and $\tau$ is normalized on rank-one operators by the usual trace.

Construction of traces. Let $\varphi\colon z(\mathbb{N}_0)\to\mathbb{C}$ be a linear form that is invariant under the operator $\tfrac{1}{2}S_+$, i.e.\ $\varphi(\tfrac{1}{2}S_+ x)=\varphi(x)$ for all $x\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$. For $S\in\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ and a $z$-representation $S=\sum_{k\ge 0} S_k$, define
$$\varphi_z(S)=\varphi\bigl((2^{-k}\,\mathrm{trace}(S_k))_{k\ge 0}\bigr),$$
where $\mathrm{trace}(S_k)$ denotes the ordinary trace of the finite-rank operator $S_k$. This expression is independent of the chosen $z$-representation and yields a trace on $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$.

Problem. Show that for every shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, every trace $\tau$ on the operator ideal $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ arises from some $\tfrac{1}{2}S_+$-invariant linear form $\varphi$ on $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ by the construction $\tau=\varphi_z$ above. Equivalently, prove that no traces on $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ exist other than those obtained in this way.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in Pietsch's program on traces on Banach-space operator ideals. Web search returns the survey itself and related works (Pietsch; Levitina–Pietsch–Sukochev–Zanin), which resolve some companion problems (e.g., completeness) but no source indicates a resolution of this particular classification of traces on $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_z$ in the Banach-space setting. The Hilbert-space analogue is known, but the general Banach-space statement appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Listed among the explicit open problems stated by Pietsch in this survey.
status_evidence.claim: The classification of all traces on L^{APP}_z is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Spectrum of Shift Operators and the Existence of Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies existence and structure of traces on operator ideals via shift-invariant linear forms.
status_evidence.claim: Related companion problems on traces have been studied, but no full classification on Banach-space L^{APP}_z is reported.
